needs.proposedSignature: AbilityCost.sacrifice becomes `Filter | { filter: Filter; count: number | 'X' }`
needs.semantics: 'Sacrifice three creatures' as a cost. Today `sacrifice` is a bare Filter and means exactly one, so Dread Return's flashback cost would be a third of what the card prints — and `covers` would still accept the altCost (the line prints no mana symbols), so the wrong magnitude would pass the checker unnoticed.
